name: maze-llm-benchmark-v1
description:
Maze LLM Benchmark (multi-size × multi-algorithm)
	

This dataset was generated with the maze-dataset library using the
LatticeMazeGenerators algorithms (DFS, Wilson, Percolation, DFS+Percolation).
Each example includes an ASCII maze (map) without solution marks, the
generation algorithm, grid_n, the shortest-path path_length, and the
NESW moves string of the shortest path.
Grid sizes: [5, 7, 9, 11, 13]Algorithms: ['dfs', 'wilson', 'recdiv', 'percolation', 'dfs_percolation']Examples… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/erdem-erdem/maze-llm-benchmark-v1.
reputation: A niche benchmark used by researchers studying algorithmic and spatial reasoning in LLMs; useful for testing pathfinding/algorithmic capabilities but not widely adopted outside that community.
